items.prompt: Listen. Interviewer: When did you start dancing? Girl: When I was five, but I only joined a dance school last year. When did she join a dance school?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
She started at five, but joined later. Listen for "only".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Last year.

items.prompt: Listen. Man: The train to the city leaves from platform four at half past three. Woman: Is there an earlier one? Man: Yes, at ten past three, from platform two. Which platform is the earlier train from?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Which train is earlier, ten past three or half past three?
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Platform two.

items.prompt: Listen. Boy: I thought the film would be boring, but it was really exciting. What did the boy think of the film?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for what he thought at the end.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: It was exciting.

items.prompt: Listen. Teacher: Your project must be about an animal or a plant. You can work alone or with a partner, but you must finish by Thursday. What must students do by Thursday?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "must".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Finish their project.

items.prompt: Listen. Girl: Would you like to come to my party on Saturday? Boy: I would love to, but I have a swimming lesson in the morning. Girl: That is fine, the party starts at two in the afternoon. Why can the boy still go to the party?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Compare morning and two in the afternoon.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: His lesson is in the morning.

options.text: His lesson is in the morning

items.prompt: Listen. Guide: Please do not feed the animals, and keep to the path. Visitors may take photographs, but not with a flash. What may visitors do?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "may" and "not".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Take photographs without a flash.

items.prompt: Listen. Woman: I used to live in a small village, but now I live in a big city. I miss the quiet, but I enjoy the shops. What does she enjoy about the city?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
She misses one thing and enjoys another.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: The shops.

items.prompt: Listen. Dad: If we leave at seven, we will arrive before lunch. If we leave at nine, we will be late. When will they arrive before lunch?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the time after "if".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: If they leave at seven.
